Subject: Stability holdback & cutover approval — HealthLedger private patch v2.14.1

Team, Chris,

We have a request from HealthLedger to apply their private deployment patch (Redwood service bundle v2.14.1) across their VPC/on‑prem footprint next week. This thread is to capture the proposed plan, version‑pinning strategy, rollback criteria, and approval items so legal/compliance and HealthLedger can sign off. Attaching the runbook and network diagram for reference.

High level plan
- Prestage: pin a subset of nodes (control plane and 10% of inferencing fleet) to the pre-release label v2.14.0-staged for 24 hrs to validate telemetry.
- Upgrade window: proposed 2026-05-22 01:00–03:00 UTC (HealthLedger prefers off-peak).
- Rollout: canary -> tranche (25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 30m observation between tranches.
- Rollback: immediate revert to pinned snapshot + redeploy v2.14.0-staged, plus KV-cache warm restart; abort if QPS drop > 18% or latency p50 regresses > 250ms above baseline for 10m.

Specific asks (please respond in-thread):
1) Approval for the maintenance window (HealthLedger needs final ok).
2) Confirm version pin approach is acceptable (we will keep pins for 72 hrs post-upgrade).
3) Network cutover readout: Logan, can you confirm the BGP drain and failover checklist and whether the net diagram needs changes?
4) Neha/Karthik: any additional safety gates (health checks, KV invalidation steps) to add to the runbook?
5) Chris: DocuSign link will be circulated for the maintenance authorization once we have internal signoff.

Attachments: maintenance-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook), network-cutover-diagram.png

Thanks — I want this to be a low‑impact, auditable change with clear abort criteria.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Rafael — quick notes, thanks for the clear runbook.

- Window: May 22 works for us but suggestion to shift to 2026-05-23 23:00–01:00 UTC (one less competing job in HL infra). If HealthLedger insists on 22, we can still support it.
- KV cache: ensure the runbook includes a step to take a KV snapshot and an explicit warm-restart sequence for runtime caches. If a rollback occurs we must not attempt in-place cache reuse without an invalidation/rehydration window (adds ~6–8 minutes but prevents weird tokenization regressions).
- Health checks: add an endpoint-level canary probe (both /health and model-inference p95 synthetic queries) with an automatic pause in rollout if either fails twice in a 10m window.

If we add those, I can sign the internal readiness checklist and we can ask Chris for the external sign-off.

— Neha

Folks — wrote up a couple of operational clarifications and a couple of small edits to the runbook (attached as a redline PDF; see comments in step 4 and step 9). Summary: 

1) Pin strategy: instead of a single v2.14.0-staged pin, pre-stage two labels — v2.14.0-canary (10% control) and v2.14.0-holdback (30% pool). After ~12–24 hrs of telemetry from canary, move holdback to v2.14.0-staged and then cutover to v2.14.1 in tranches. This gives us a faster rollback ladder (we can fall back to holdback without restoring snapshots in many cases).

2) Network cutover: Logan — add step to pre-populate static ARP on the edge switch during BGP withdraw to avoid ARP storms during container IP churn (diagram updated). Also add a short net-verify step after each tranche (ICMP + service port smoke).

3) Rollback timing: define the formal abort point at 2 failed tranches OR one fatal condition (controller heartbeat lost, or persistent KV corruption). If we hit abort, we will immediately reassign traffic to holdback label and roll back control-plane pods to v2.14.0-canary snapshots.

4) Metrics and alerting: add a temporary prometheus rule for a 3x alert sensitivity during the 6-hr post-upgrade window; pager duty escalation to our private-deploys rotation.

I can join the sync with HealthLedger tomorrow if needed.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Lead infra engineer, Private Runtime

Thanks all — summary and next steps (please action):

Decisions made
- Window: agreed to 2026-05-23 23:00–01:00 UTC (HealthLedger accepted the shift).
- Pin ladder: adopt Karthik's two-label pre-stage approach (v2.14.0-canary and v2.14.0-holdback).
- KV/caches: snapshot + explicit invalidate/rehydrate sequence before and after rollback per Neha.
- Additional probes and temporary alert sensitivity will be added.

Owners & actions
- Karthik: update runbook with the pre-populate ARP step and formal abort point (deadline: 2026-05-20 17:00 UTC).
- Neha: add the canary p95 probe and KV snapshot steps to the readiness checklist (deadline: 2026-05-20 17:00 UTC).
- Logan: confirm network diagram changes and BGP drain checklist; publish a short dry‑run checklist for HL ops (deadline: 2026-05-21 09:00 UTC).
- Monica: prepare the DocuSign maintenance authorization and ping Chris for signature; include the related Drive link.

Chris — if you can confirm the final authorization on the DocuSign link by 2026-05-21 17:00 UTC, we'll treat that as the go/no-go point. If anything changes on HL side, please reply with the altered window.
